answer_1.quote: In this work, we proposed a novel model for contextual response generation in multi-turn dialogue. ... We test the proposed approach with two benchmarks: Daily-Dialog and PersonaChat.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our model on various aspects of response quality using both automatic and human evaluation. For response content quality we measured BLEU-4 and Perplexity(PPL). ... we also measured the informativeness of responses with distinct-1 and distinct-2.

answer_4.quote: We picked 500 dialogues from the test set and asked 3 native speakers for their judgement. In the first setting, we asked judges to pick the better response among the one generated by our model and a baseline model (Pre-Trained GPT2) based on various criteria like answerability and semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Judges were asked to compare responses and select the better one based on answerability and semantics, and to evaluate whole multi-turn simulated conversations for overall quality.
